description:
When to use: the caller wants the market signals that fired on this portfolio, or whether the index the book hedges against crossed the point where dealer hedging switches from calming to amplifying.

    Inputs: portfolio_id from list_portfolios. The caller's token is the owner scope. Do not pass a user id or a symbol list. The route reads that portfolio's holdings.

    What comes back: the route JSON, unchanged. alerts is one row per holding signal, with symbol, book, side, kind, reason, and fired_at. index_alerts is the gamma-flip row for the index the route watches, and the route names that symbol. An empty list means no alert. A holding the route could not score is named in missing and is not a quiet signal. A portfolio the token does not own is the same not-found answer as a missing id.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID from list_portfolios

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_signal_alerts
title: Get portfolio signal alerts
